summary.summary: The listing describes Meta Crush Saga as a C++17 game implemented at compile time, and the page is a blog post by Jean Guegant. The text captured from the page, however, is an excerpt from a different post dated 17 May 2020 about how C++17 structured bindings work under the standard, so no game mechanics, code or results are visible.
